meta.title: About
meta.subtitle: Technical Director, educator, and API problem-solver. Based in Wales, UK.

bio: I help SaaS teams fix slow, unreliable APIs without rewriting everything. My work sits at the intersection of API quality, architecture, developer enablement, and the delivery decisions that determine whether a team ships with confidence or spends half its time firefighting.

I've been building software professionally for over 15 years — the last several focused on PHP, Laravel, and API systems at scale. I'm a PHP-FIG Core Committee member and have delivered 30+ talks and workshops internationally on APIs, architecture, and developer tooling. I've reached 50,000+ developers through writing, talks, and technical education.

Before software, I served in the Royal Engineers from 2007 to 2011. That background shapes how I approach complex problems: systematic diagnosis, calm under pressure, and a preference for durable solutions over heroics.
My consulting approach is built around three stages: Diagnose the actual failure points, Stabilise the riskiest bottlenecks first, then Scale by leaving behind patterns the team can own permanently.
